entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Yeah, I just need to make a return. Quickly.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. I can definitely help you with a return. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?
Sarah Jenkins. Order is VF98765. I need to return a helmet.
Thank you, Sarah. I see the order right here. Just so I can process this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. The color is wrong. My husband said he liked the blue one online, but it's too bright in person. The box is unopened, it's exactly as it arrived.
I completely understand. So just to confirm, the issue is simply the color and there are no concerns about the fit or the safety features of the helmet itself?
Correct. It's just the color. Can I return it, yes or no?

Yes, you absolutely can. I see you received the helmet nine days ago, which is unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy for standard gear. Since the box is still unopened, it's a straightforward process.
Okay, good. What's the next step?

I've just approved the return on my end and I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. You can print that out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Does that work for you?
You're very welcome, Sarah. Thanks for calling VeloFit. Have a great day!
